test-fs-promises-file-handle-aggregate-e.reason: Requires --expose-internals: monkey-patches real Node's internal FileHandle.prototype.fd (via require('internal/fs/promises')) to inject op/close failures. The shim's FileHandle is a separate memfs-backed class, so the patch never fires; the AggregateError path is unreachable in this lane. Fails identically at pristine base 1a89d258.

test-fs-promises-file-handle-close-error.reason: Requires --expose-internals: wraps real Node's internal FileHandle.prototype.close via an fd-getter patch on require('internal/fs/promises'). The shim never instantiates real Node's FileHandle, so the injected CLOSE_ERROR never occurs. Fails identically at pristine base 1a89d258.

test-fs-promises-file-handle-op-errors.j.reason: Requires --expose-internals: replaces real Node's internal FileHandle.prototype.fd getter (via require('internal/fs/promises')) to throw INTERNAL_ERROR. The shim's path-based truncate/readFile/writeFile use its own FileHandle class; the patch is invisible to them. Fails identically at pristine base 1a89d258.
